mg.title: Orbassano pin
mg.src: Blueprint location pin “📍 Orbassano, Italy”. IMG_7834.MOV [00:00] “I come from Italy”.

mg.title: More than 10 years
mg.src: Italy Lion, IMG_7834.MOV [00:00] “for more than 10 years”
mg.use: As he says it, after the Orbassano pin is gone. One text at a time.

mg.title: Love at first sight

text.main: It was a love at first sight

mg.use: Over him as the new clip starts. Check the Italian first.

mg.title: Important for Orbassano

text.main: made us important for Orbassano and Orbassano important for us.

mg.title: Totally different from ours

text.main: a world that is equal but totally different from ours

mg.use: Over his last line. Hold 0.5 s after “ours”, then out.

mg.title: Every single nation

text.main: The main advice is to enjoy every single nation present in this convention

mg.use: Only in the convention version, as he says it. Leave it out of the evergreen cut.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Only the official Lions lockup from the Lions brand files. Nothing else on it.
mg.src: Lions' latest end card video (Lions CTA.mp4, sent as the latest Lions end card on Slack, 20 Aug 2026): the Lions emblem on the brand gradient with Find your local club at lionsclubs.org.
